summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $10B+ in BuyCall premium for SPX and an extremely low P/C ratio of 0.30. Significant directional conviction is visible in the massive accumulation of SPX 7000C strikes for 2026, with single expirations (e.g., 2026-10-16) seeing nearly $3B in single-contract buys. Persistent institutional interest is confirmed by multi-day accumulation in SPX 7000C and 6000C strikes, totaling billions in premium over the last four sessions. Traders should watch for continued upside momentum in SPX and semiconductor names like NVDA and AMD, which are showing aggressive call-side dominance (P/C ratios of 0.28 and 0.37, respectively).
